ordering: Current-thread runtime; ownership write held in actual adapter before SQLite effect
result: Independent heartbeat/timer advances while write remains held.

ordering: Same for ownership read held at query/decode
result: Heartbeat advances; read result remains pending then validates real snapshot.

ordering: FileRecords nonsecret load/store held at actual file helper
result: Heartbeat advances; actual JSON/durability path resumes and completes.

ordering: FileRecords secret load/store/delete held at physical helper
result: Heartbeat advances; actual sealing/file/delete operation resumes with existing typed result.

ordering: FileAuthorizationAudit held at actual append/sync helper
result: Heartbeat advances; real secret-free record appended only after gate release.

ordering: A holds instance worker; B/C wait async admission
result: Only A submitted/started; no growing blocking jobs; heartbeat continues.

ordering: B canceled while waiting admission
result: B creates no worker/effect; A completes; next waiter can admit.

ordering: A admitted and queued in blocking pool; A caller drops before closure starts
result: A still owns slot; B cannot start; A executes once when pool permits.

ordering: A executing actual SQLite write; caller drops; B write/read arrives
result: Permit remains held; B starts only after A physical completion; final snapshot order follows existing coordinator fence.

ordering: A executing secret write; caller drops; delete/load/replacement arrives
result: All same-instance operations excluded until A ends; no late old publication after the later delete/replacement.

ordering: A executing delete; caller drops; replacement secret write arrives
result: Replacement waits for actual delete completion, then publishes; old delete cannot later remove replacement.

ordering: Audit A caller drops mid append; audit B arrives
result: B waits until A physical append/sync ends; successful appends retain existing order and secret-free fields; interruption may leave partial bytes and is reported as failure.

ordering: Worker panics before effect
result: Typed conservative method outcome; permit eventually available; no fake absence/acknowledgement.

ordering: Worker executes write/publish/delete/append then panics
result: Ownership Uncertain; secret Unknown; delete Unknown; audit failure; recovery/load observes actual disk outcome.

ordering: Disk/read/decode/lock-poison failure
result: Correct typed failure; no empty snapshot/None invented; no runtime-thread lock wait.

ordering: Ownership newer revision publishes before older snapshot reaches coordinator fence
result: Existing fence skips old copy; worker adapter does not bypass/duplicate fence.

ordering: Adapter instance A held; independent instance B/directory operation
result: B can progress; no new global lock/serialization guarantee.

ordering: Panic/caller disappearance while worker state/input cleanup is still physical work
result: Permit covers worker completion; later operation never starts merely because its original waiter exited.

ordering: Port future first polled without a Tokio context
result: Typed pre-effect unavailability; constructor does not need a runtime; no panic/effect/worker submission.

ordering: Send port future starts waiting for admission in Tokio and resumes on an ordinary thread
result: Admission carries its originating executor; live originating runtime executes the physical job and caller observes actual result.

ordering: Originating executor shuts down after admission began
result: No promise of runtime-independent completion; failed join stays typed conservative unavailability/uncertainty.

ordering: Caller disappears before physical operation panics with a faulting panic payload
result: Physical Job catches call panic while still owning capture; forgets payload without inspection; captured cleanup remains under permit even without caller.

ordering: Central queued blocking task is aborted before start with a detached caller; separately an actual adapter resumes after its captured executor stopped and submission is refused, then its capture destructor faults
result: Job::Drop catches/takes captured operation before automatic permit release; next same-instance operation waits through actual input cleanup; payload destructor stays uncalled even without its waiter. The actual rejected-submission witness checks typed interruption and actual captured cleanup. It does not claim detached caller loss during synchronous rejected submission. Runtime shutdown does not cancel an already queued blocking operation.

ordering: Actual storage effect returns a ready result; owned input destructor then faults, with its caller awaiting or detached
result: Captured-operation Drop is caught separately while permit is held; dispose ready result under a separate catch and report interruption, never acknowledgement/absence.

ordering: Admission is acquired but never submitted, then dropped
result: Empty admission releases its instance slot; no operation or capture exists.

ordering: Synchronous submit returns its awaitable, which is dropped before first poll
result: Job was already handed to the captured executor; operation/capture cleanup remains under the slot through completion.
